All people on board—the pilot and four passengers, including club chairman Vichai Srivaddhanaprabha—were killed in the crash.

candidates.description: River in the West Midlands of England
candidates.extract: The River Tame is a river in the West Midlands of England, and one of the principal tributaries of the River Trent.
